title: cycle

messages.description: message to cycle through the outlets, one element per outlet
a float or a symbol atom element, depending on the input

arguments.description: mode: Nonzero sets to "event sensitive mode

methods.description: sets the next output outlet (starting at 0)

body: Each incoming number is sent to the next outlet, wrapping around to the first outlet after the last has been reached, completing a cycle in a "round-robin scheduling" way.
